goal: Lily (drawn young, about five years old) stands in front of a small white house with a red door and a green garden, and points at the house. No letters, words, or numbers anywhere.

Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The children keep their chibi proportions: a big head and a small body; the adults keep the adult proportions of their pictures (about one and a half times as tall as the five-year-old children; Tom, who is eight, is a little taller than Lily). linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture.
